Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

wide adjective

measuring a lot from side to side

also broad, width, widely, far and wide, how wide, extensive, extensively, spacious

classical

Mart. 13.81.1: quamvīs lāta gerat patella rhombum
Caes. BG 7.19.1: nōn lātior pedibus quīnquāgintā
Traupman 283
Traupman 407

lātus, lāta, lātum

wide, broad

The width is lātitūdō: in lātitūdinem patēre, to extend in width (Caes. BG 1.2.5).

Other words

  • lātē — widely, far and wide

    adverb · also used · classical · Liv. 21.35.8: unde longē ac lātē prōspectus erat; Publ. L 16: lātē lūcēre

    longē lātēque, far and wide.

  • amplus, ampla, amplum — spacious, roomy

    also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.139: ampla domus; Traupman 383

Examples

  • quamvīs lāta gerat patella rhombum, rhombus lātior est tamen patellā

    however wide the dish that holds the turbot, the turbot is still wider than the dishMart. 13.81.1–2

  • hunc ex omnibus ferē partibus palūs difficilis atque impedīta cingēbat nōn lātior pedibus quīnquāgintā

    on almost every side it was surrounded by a difficult, treacherous marsh, no more than fifty feet wideCaes. BG 7.19.1

See also avenue, big, long, be awake, range, narrow.
